pages.title: Cool Planning
pages.text: Connect drink mixing with a separate cooling workstation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The Palm Bar mixes recipe ingredients. The Mini Fridge processes water and ice through its own recipes; it is a separate workstation, not merely a chest.

pages.title: Mix a cocktail
pages.text: A Palm Bar combines a cocktail's recipe ingredients and delivers it after processing.

pages.title: Freeze supplies
pages.text: A Mini Fridge processes water and ice through native cooling recipes. Merely storing items does not prove cooling them.
